item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya heats a pot of water on a stove in her kitchen. The water at the bottom of the pot is heated first. Which statement correctly describes how the rest of the water becomes hot?

options.A: The heated water expands, becomes lighter and rises, while cooler water moves down to take its place.
options.B: The heated water becomes heavier and sinks, pushing the cooler water up to the top.
options.C: Heat travels through the water only when the water starts boiling and bubbles appear.
options.D: The warm water stays at the bottom, and the rest of the pot heats up without any water moving.
